name: MURA
description: Mura is an unusual Hungarian card game for four players. It is a trick-avoidance game where players try not to win tricks, but with a twist: only certain cards (figures) have value, and winning tricks without figures is actually beneficial. The game uses a 32-card Hungarian deck with unique ranking.

content.text: Mura is an unusual Hungarian card game for four players. It is a trick-avoidance game where players try not to win tricks, but with a twist: only certain cards (figures) have value, and winning tricks without figures is actually beneficial. The game uses a 32-card Hungarian deck with unique ranking.
Mura originated in Hungary, with a 1937 article claiming it was played by rural aristocrats and judicial officials in a patriarchal region of old Hungary. The inventor and exact origins are unknown.

32-card Hungarian pack. Suits: Hearts (Piros), Gourds (Tok), Leaves (Zold), Acorns (Makk). Ranking: X, IX, Ace, King, Over (Felso), Under (Also), VIII, VII. Note: X and IX are high, Ace is third highest.
Hungarian deck or modified standard deck, score sheet.
8 cards to each player, dealt in packets. Deal and play are counter-clockwise.

items.text: Point Scoring Variant: Some variants use point-based scoring rather than direct figure counting.
